title: 第一卷 第11章 玉露丹你别乱叫啊第一卷 第12章 妙不可言的解毒方式
content_zh:
云梦儿看着秦逸远去的背影，她那苍白的脸上浮现抹无奈之色，瞳孔深处则是透着一丝绝望。
下一刻，云梦儿也转身离去。
只能自己去争取一条活路。
可就在云梦儿刚动身之际，四面八方，一道道身影，激射而来，将她包围。
为首之人，乃是一个身穿华贵长袍的年轻男子。
此人看上去倒是英俊，可双目之中却带着一丝淫邪的光芒。
“你逃啊，怎么不逃了？”
“本皇子说过，你逃不掉！”
“你还是老老实实从了本皇子吧，本皇子保证让你爽上天！”
“而且，成为本皇子的女人，你以后还有享之不尽的荣华富贵！”
云梦儿咬着唇，深吸了一口气，道：“夏非凡，我就算死，也不会让你得逞！”
“竟敢直呼十三皇子名讳，你好大的胆子！”
“十三皇子看上你，这是你的荣幸！”
“你别不识好歹！”
包围云梦儿的人，发出怒斥声。
而此刻，还未走远的秦逸，却忽然停了下来。
“这个夏非凡，竟然是大夏皇朝的十三皇子？”秦逸心中暗道。
夏非凡的名字，在空中显示星辰点数量的光幕上，排第六。
荒古大陆，共有三个皇朝，分别是大夏皇朝，大楚皇朝，大风皇朝。
而秦家，位于大夏皇朝的境内。

由于秦家九子声名鹊起，大夏皇室之人，对秦家极为重视，当今大夏皇帝，甚至还册封了秦沧为大夏天师。
这个大夏天师，虽然没有实际权力，但却待遇拉满，能随意进出大夏皇宫，在大夏皇帝面前都不需要跪拜。
大夏皇朝十三皇子夏非凡的身边，忽然有人低声说道：“启禀十三皇子，那个人……是秦逸。”
夏非凡看向秦逸的方向，目光一闪，随即道：“他杀了秦天师的儿子秦永，既然被本皇子遇到了，就顺便解决掉。”
“你去杀了他。”
“本皇子要跟这娇滴滴的美娘子好好探讨人生！”
“是！”
顿时，一个凝罡境九重修为的家伙，立刻朝着秦逸冲去。
夏非凡的注意力，重新转移到了云梦儿的身上，看着云梦儿那漂亮的脸蛋，还有饱满的身材，他不由得吞了一口唾沫，喉结滚动。
身为大夏皇朝的十三皇子，他玩过的女人不计其数，但云梦儿这么极品的，他还是第一次遇到。
第一眼看到云梦儿，他就下定了决心，必须要品尝此等极品的滋味，他可不喜欢等待，所以连带人去猎杀妖兽收集星辰点的事都放在了一边。
“都给我听好了，可别将她的身子弄出伤痕来！”夏非凡舔着嘴唇说道。
另外一边。
奉夏非凡的命令，冲向秦逸的凝罡境九重武者，脚踏气浪，速度极快。
他冲到了秦逸身后，手中一把长刀，迸发寒光，凝聚出巨大的刀芒，狠狠朝着秦逸的头颅劈去。
content_en:
Yun Meng'er looked at Qin Yi's retreating back, a look of helplessness appeared on her pale face, and there was a hint of despair deep in her pupils.
The next moment, Yun Meng'er also turned and left.
You can only fight for a way to survive by yourself.
But just as Yun Meng'er was about to leave, figures shot out from all directions, surrounding her.
The leader was a young man wearing a luxurious robe.
This man looked handsome, but there was a hint of lust in his eyes.
"You ran away, why didn't you run away?"
"This prince said that you can't escape!"
"You should just obey me honestly. I promise to make you happy!"
"Moreover, as a woman of this prince, you will enjoy endless glory and wealth in the future!"
Yun Meng'er bit her lip, took a deep breath, and said, "Xia Feifan, even if I die, I won't let you succeed!"
"You dare to call the Thirteenth Prince by his first name, how brave you are!"
"It's your honor that the Thirteenth Prince has taken a liking to you!"
"Don't be ignorant!"
The people surrounding Yun Meng'er yelled angrily.
At this moment, Qin Yi, who had not gone far, suddenly stopped.
"This Xia Feifan is actually the thirteenth prince of the Great Xia Dynasty?" Qin Yi thought to himself.
Xia Feifan's name ranked sixth on the light screen showing the number of star points in the sky.
There are three dynasties in the ancient continent, namely the Daxia Dynasty, the Dachu Dynasty and the Gale Dynasty.
The Qin family was located within the territory of the Great Xia Dynasty.
Due to the fame of the nine sons of the Qin family, the Daxia royal family attached great importance to the Qin family. The current emperor of Daxia even named Qin Cang as the Grand Master of Daxia.
Although this Great Xia Master had no actual power, he was well paid and could enter and leave the Great Xia Palace at will. He did not need to kneel before the Great Xia Emperor.
Next to Xia Feifan, the thirteenth prince of the Great Xia Dynasty, someone suddenly whispered: "Reporting to the thirteenth prince, that person... is Qin Yi."
Xia Feifan looked in the direction of Qin Yi, his eyes flashed, and then he said: "He killed Qin Tianshi's son Qin Yong. Since he was encountered by this prince, he will be dealt with by the way."
"You go and kill him."
"This prince wants to discuss life with this delicate and beautiful lady!"
"Yes!"
Suddenly, a guy who was at the ninth level of Ning Gang Realm rushed towards Qin Yi.
Xia Feifan's attention shifted to Yun Meng'er again. Looking at Yun Meng'er's beautiful face and plump figure, he couldn't help but swallow a mouthful of saliva and his Adam's apple rolled.
As the thirteenth prince of the Great Xia Dynasty, he has played with countless women, but this is the first time he has encountered such a top-notch Yun Meng'er.
When he first saw Yun Meng'er, he made up his mind that he must taste this exquisite taste. He didn't like to wait, so he even put aside the matter of taking people to hunt monsters and collect star points.
"Listen to me, but don't cause any scars on her body!" Xia Feifan said, licking his lips.
The other side.
Following Xia Feifan's order, he rushed towards Qin Yi, a ninth-level warrior of the Condensation Realm, riding on the air waves at extremely fast speeds.
He rushed behind Qin Yi, with a long knife in his hand, bursting with cold light, condensing a huge sword light, and slashed towards Qin Yi's head.
